title: Assembling Algal Shaker
author: Jakub Nedbal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdcdi2s6

steps.title: Prepare workbench
steps.instruction: Clear a tidy workbench with sufficient space and illumination to minimize risk of accidents.

steps.title: Install platform standoffs
steps.instruction: Secure four standoffs to the orbital shaker platform using nuts and washers.

substeps.instruction: Place four M4×50 mm male‑female standoffs (or #8‑32×2" standoffs if Imperial threads are preferred) into the holes at each corner of the platform.
Fasten each standoff with a nut and washer, tightening with wrenches and/or pliers.

steps.title: Position LED illuminator
steps.instruction: Lay the cooled LED illuminator onto the orbital shaker platform between the installed standoffs.

steps.title: Mount acrylic sheet
steps.instruction: Place the clear acrylic sheet over the standoffs and align its mounting holes with the standoffs.

steps.title: Add antislip mat and pierce holes
steps.instruction: Cover the acrylic sheet with the supplied antislip mat, then create holes for mounting.

substeps.instruction: Lay the antislip mat (antislip face up) over the clear acrylic sheet.
Pierce small holes through the mat at the positions of the mounting holes using a needle or a sharp blade.

steps.title: Secure sheet with screws
steps.instruction: Fix the acrylic sheet and antislip mat to the shaker platform with screws and washers.

substeps.instruction: Use M4×12 mm screws and washers (or #8‑32 UNC×1/2" screws and washers if Imperial sizes are preferred) to attach the assembly to the platform.

steps.title: Program day/night timer
steps.instruction: Set the 24‑hour timer to the desired light cycle.

substeps.instruction: Set the current time on the timer.
Program the day period to start at 6 AM and finish at 8 PM (example cycle).
Follow the timer’s specific method: manual timers are programmed by pushing in or raising dial switches; digital timers are programmed via the screen according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Connect power supply and plug devices
steps.instruction: Wire the power supply and plug all components into mains power.

substeps.instruction: Connect the 30 V/1 A power supply to the LED controller power input.
Plug the power supply into the 24‑hour timer.
Plug the 24‑hour timer into a mains socket.
Plug the orbital shaker into a separate mains socket.

steps.title: Activate LED and shaker
steps.instruction: Turn on the illumination and start the shaker at the desired speed.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the LED to the desired power setting using the toggle switch and rotary switch on the LED controller (the illuminator may need to be temporarily removed to reach the switches).
Set the orbital shaker speed to the desired value (100 rpm in this example) and turn the shaker on.

description: Summary This protocol finished the assembly of the illuminated orbital shaker for microalgae culture. The cooled LED illuminator has been installed onto the shaker platform and a new light-transmissive antislip platform was built over the illuminator.
